Card Q&A.a: No. Even if 2 or more Digimon with [Sistermon] in their names are played at the same time, you only gain 1 memory by this card’s effect.
Card Q&A.q: If I play 2 or more Digimon with [Sistermon] in their names at the same time, do I gain 1 memory for each Digimon played?

Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When you play a Digimon with [Sistermon] in its name, gain 1 memory.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While this Digimon has [Huckmon] in its name or [Royal Knight] in its traits, it gets +1000 DP.
